mines.mine_notes: Open-pit heap leach gold mine in western Turkey. 2025 production 168,701 oz (down 3% from 174,080 oz in 2024) on lower grade and tonnes placed on pad (12.87 Mt placed, 154,582 recoverable oz stacked). Cash costs and AISC rose on higher Turkish royalties (price-linked sliding scale broadened in July 2025) and local cost inflation.

Underground gold mine in western Turkey producing a gold concentrate (payable metal). 2025 production 72,482 payable oz (down 10% from 80,143 oz in 2024) on lower grades. Recovery to concentrate 91.3%. Costs rose on higher royalties and Turkish labour inflation.

Underground gold mine (Triangle mine) in Val-d'Or, Quebec; ore processed at the Sigma mill. 2025 production 187,208 oz (down 5% from 196,538 oz in 2024) on lower grades and recoveries, partly offset by higher throughput. Recovery 94.3%.

Underground gold-silver-lead-zinc mine in northern Greece (part of Kassandra Mines). Produces a gold concentrate plus lead-silver and zinc concentrates. 2025: 59,877 payable oz Au, 1,083,313 payable oz Ag, 10,195 t Pb, 9,923 t Zn (down 14% on gold due to flotation circuit instability and equipment availability). Gold recovery to concentrate 78.2%. Cash costs/AISC are per oz gold sold with silver/lead/zinc revenues netted against costs.
mines.processing: Flotation (gold concentrate + lead-silver and zinc concentrates)

mines.mine_notes: Copper-gold porphyry development project (part of Kassandra Mines), mined via combined open pit and underground. In construction; commercial production expected Q4 2026 (20-40 M lb Cu and 60-100 koz Au pre-commercial production guided for 2026).
Underground silver-lead-zinc mine (Mavres Petres + Stratoni facility) on care and maintenance. No reserves reported in the 2025 AIF.
mines.processing: Silver-lead-zinc mine on care and maintenance

mines.mine_notes: Gold-silver development project in northern Greece (oxide reserves only). Pre-permitting stage; no 2025 production or costs disclosed.

notes: All operating data from Eldorado Gold Corporation Form 40-F for FY2025, which embeds the 2025 Annual Information Form and Management's Discussion and Analysis for the three and twelve months ended December 31, 2025 (filed with the SEC; downloaded from minedocs). Four operating gold mines: Kisladağ, Efemçukuru, Lamaque Complex, Olympias. Olympias production figures are payable metal (59,877 oz Au payable, 1,083,313 oz Ag payable, 10,195 t Pb, 9,923 t Zn). Olympias by-product revenues (silver, lead, zinc) are offset against total cash costs. Reserve/resource figures are from AIF Table 1/Table 2, effective September 30, 2025 (not December 31, 2025). Skouries commercial production expected Q4 2026. Stratoni silver-lead-zinc mine is on care and maintenance. Perama Hill is a development project (oxide reserves 8.91 Mt @ 3.18 g/t Au = 912 koz). Jinfeng (China) is not mentioned in the 2025 40-F and is not held by the company. All amounts in USD unless otherwise noted.
